//vod: Optional external VOD provider block. The provider's COORDINATES (apiBase / service / sources / params) are NEVER configured here - they come from the operator's panel at login, and the Movies & Series section only exists while the panel has a provider enabled. The only thing this block may carry is a DEV credential override, below.

vod._comment: DEV ONLY. In production the app passes the VIEWER's own app username and password to the provider, so no credential belongs in a descriptor. Fill this in only in a LOCAL, GITIGNORED config/service.json when testing against a provider account that is not a viewer account, and NEVER ship a build whose descriptor contains it (the file is baked into the packaged app's resources). Left as the placeholder words below, the block is ignored and the normal viewer pass-off applies.
